description: With the greatest efforts to make it!
summary:
After a mission ends, some equipment remains on the Moon. These machines once helped us observe an unfamiliar world. Their stories can still inspire future explorers.

This project invites students to ask: when a machine finishes its mission, does its story end too?
details:
Project Idea

Future versions could include equipment cards, a mission timeline, and a short quiz. This page is a text-only prototype.
